headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Risk Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency risk analysis to provide users with up-to-date security insights. Incorporate agent-based monitoring for dynamic threat detection and improve the user interface for better accessibility.
actions: Implement a feature that fetches and displays real-time vulnerability data from public databases like NVD, Snyk, or OWASP.
Develop an agent-based monitoring system to detect changes in dependencies and notify users of potential risks before installation.
Redesign the user interface to make it more intuitive, including clear visual indicators for risk levels and easy-to-understand explanations.
